decisions.sponsor_acknowledgment_text: This project was made possible by the generous support of [Sponsor Name].

commitments.detail: Ensure all archival images are reproduced as per the catalog requirements.
Verify that all necessary permissions for reproducing images and text have been obtained.
Include a cover image and ensure it adheres to the approved design guidelines.
Prepare a tagged PDF version of the catalog for accessibility.
Place the sponsor acknowledgment at the end of the catalog.
